name: Platypelta
sum: Platypelta is an ankylosaurine from the Dinosaur Park Formation of Alberta, erected in 2018 for a skeleton once placed in Euoplocephalus.
holotype: AMNH 5337, a skeleton found in 1914 by Barnum Brown and Peter Kaisen at Sand Creek near the Red Deer River — Dinosaur Park Formation, Alberta.
material: Large rump plates exceeding 25 cm in length with a sharp keel.
biology: Armoured herbivore with large keeled plates on the rump.
author: Penkalski 2018

images.artist: Victoria M. Arbour, Philip J. Currie
images.caption: Holotype specimen AMNH 5337 of Platypelta.
